scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build -w @boutique/shared && concurrently -n gateway,auth,users,products,orders,payment,wishlist "npm run dev -w backend/services/gateway --ignore-scripts" "npm run dev -w backend/services/auth --ignore-scripts" "npm run dev -w backend/services/user-service --ignore-scripts" "npm run dev -w backend/services/product-service --ignore-scripts" "npm run dev -w backend/services/orders --ignore-scripts" "npm run dev -w backend/services/payment --ignore-scripts" "npm run dev -w backend/services/wishlist-service --ignore-scripts"
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @boutique/shared && npm run build -w backend/services --ignore-scripts
